resources.string: Pair with code
Instead of pasting a token: type the short code RomM shows under Client API Tokens → Pair device. A code works once and for one minute.
Pair

In RomM\'s web interface open your profile, then Client API Tokens, and press Pair device on a token. Type the 8-character code here. RomM gives that token a new secret, which this app saves as its RomM token; an app that still uses the old secret of that token has to be paired again.

Install from RomM
Press Install on device in RomM\'s web interface and the game lands in this app\'s download queue. Switching this on first pairs this handheld with RomM. Needs a RomM server with that feature.
